posts.title: OpenAI safety employee resigns, claiming the company’s ‘culture is broken’
posts.summary: TechCrunch (Oct 3 ~16:30 UTC — NEW; Verge/BI/Decoder same cluster): OpenAI Safety Systems leader David Robinson resigns after ~3.5 years writing launch safety reports — Atlantic essay says company “culture is broken,” Silicon Valley sprint optimism blocks nuclear/aviation-grade safeguards, and stronger external incentives are needed — strongest overnight safety/policy lead beside held rogue-agent notices + internal shutdown-restart.
